name: dos-vga-adlib
scope: DOS 3.3 compatible services, VGA-compatible video BIOS and INT33 mouse convention; primary AdLib, all alternatives retained
loader: NOT an assumption: original PKLITE establishes DF=0 IF=1 at ProgramEntry (06979d5; tools/check_unpack.py)
limitations: No IRQ serialization, no protected-view composition, no physical nonalias/stack survival, no callback-writer closure, no driver allocation/vector lifetime, no hardware timing or audible equivalence is granted.
The profile is a declared service-preservation requirement, not evidence that an unidentified firmware/TSR satisfies it.
